provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, the 2023 FIFA Women's World Cup group stage as played: three matchdays, each its own event whose 16 matches form no bracket, every matchday's field all 32 teams (a team's first, second and third group match fall on matchdays 1, 2 and 3). Each match's score, its half-time score (from the goal minutes, which add up to the score in every match) and its kickoff from the group page's local time and UTC offset. Home is the side Wikipedia lists first, and every match is at a neutral site, as at every World Cup match. ESPN's scoreboards agree on kickoff, home side and score for the 10 matches of three dates. Teams are ranked by the 9 June 2023 FIFA women's ranking, as the knockout test file ranks them. Odds to win are made up from the ranking.
